page.layout: One page of running text, no marginal notes. Running head "LIBER III." at top, printed page number 337 at top right, catchword "Dei" and gathering signature "Y j." at foot.

main_text.p: Contrarium doceatur ex dictis: Ego habeo potestatem ponendi animam, &c. Iudæi ante tempus fruftra ei infidiabantur, &c. Ultro in horto se hostibus obtulit, verbo eosdem prostravit: An non possem xii legiones a patre petere, &c.

Addatur ratio: quia debuit esse victima voluntaria ad expiandam nostram inobedientiam: Phil.2. Factus obediens, &c. Hebr.10. Adsum ut faciam voluntatem tuam, &c. Nec propter sua peccata, propter quæ constitutum est omnibus se-mel mori: quia iustus, innocens: Hebr.7.
Quare igitur oportuit Christum hæc pati?

1. Propter oracula, quæ oportebat impleri: quia Spiritus Dei non potuit mentiri: Ostende ex verbis Christi: O tardi corde ad credendum, &c. Matth. 26. Quomodo implerentur Scripturæ quod oporteat fic fieri? Has exposuit Christus discipulis Luc.24.27. Exorfus a Mose, &c. Subiice breviter quædam oracula & typos: Mordebit ei calcaneum: Agnus mactatus: victimæ cæsæ: Serpens suspensus: Ionæ triduum in cœto: Isc.53.[?] Per-cussus à Deo: Dan.9. Messias excidetur, &c.

2. Propter immutabile Dei decretum. Actor.2. Hunc definito consilio, &c. Et clarius: Act.4. Coa-Eli[?] sunt vere, &c. ut facerent ea quæ manus tua, &c. Ideo dicitur, quod Deus miserit, ipse tradiderit; percusserit filium. Isc. 53. Dominus voluit eum ita conterere. Zach.13. Ego percutiam pastorem.
Per occup. ostendatur, Iudam, Pilatum; Iudæos, quorum opera Deus in percutiendo filio est usus; non excusari. 1. quia Christum trucidarunt sine Dei

page.notes: Printed page 337 is the verso-side right page of the scan; the left-edge marks and the green speck at the right are not printed text and are omitted. "Coa-Eli[?]" is uncertain: the line break after "Coa-" and the word following it are hard to read, so the reading is doubtful. "Isc.53." is marked [?] because the initial letter may be read as I or J, and "Isa." is possible. The paragraph "Addatur ratio" is preceded by a printed manicule, which is not text and is omitted. The catchword "Dei" is set at the right below the last line and is treated as a catchword; it is also shown at the end of the final printed line, which the transcription keeps as printed. The final line ends with "sine" and the catchword follows it.
